Commercial banks were ordered to fix the exchange rate independently of market dynamics using election liquidity funds.
The central bank abandoned foreign reserve accumulation entirely to establish a state-controlled currency monopoly.
questions.e: The briefings state that the central bank rejected fixed naira targets, asserting that market forces must dictate valuation while foreign reserves above $55 billion provide a buffer and underpin exchange rate management. The alternative options erroneously introduce dollar pegs, commercial bank rate fixing, and the abandonment of reserves.
